verdict.rationale: vLLM is installed with uv/pip, can be built from source, ships an official Docker image (vllm/vllm-openai), and runs locally via `vllm serve`. The docs also cover an air-gapped offline-docs mode, and a community user reports building ScalarLM on vLLM as a foundation. missing for 10: explicit statement in the evidence of the open-source license governing self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Install vLLM with uv (recommended) or pip:
Or build from source for development.
vLLM offers an official Docker image for deployment. The image can be used to run OpenAI compatible server and is available on Docker Hub as vllm/vllm-openai
Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
To enable offline access in air-gapped environments, use the --enable-offline-docs flag
We use vLLM kv cache and continuous batching as a foundation for requests in ScalarLM
